title: attempt.json
description: One attempt of a cubetrace session, schema version 1 (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §7). Times are host milliseconds (performance.timeOrigin + performance.now() on the host device), except cubeMs, the cube's own clock.

session.description: The id of the session: a lowercase UUID v4.

index.description: The attempt's 1-based position in its session.

scramble.description: Face turns separated by single spaces (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §2).

scrambledFacelets.description: The scramble applied to a solved cube: the state at scrambleDone.

crossFace.description: The face whose cross completed first (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §4); null if none did.

events.description: The events of docs/DATA-MODEL.md §3; null when they did not happen.

moves.description: Every move the cube reported, in order, corrections of a mis-scramble included.

timeMs.description: solveEnd − solveStart; null on a DNF.

inspectionMs.description: solveStart − (pickup ?? scrambleDone); null if the solve did not start.

movesQtm.description: Quarter turns of the solve's moves (a half turn counts two).

tps.description: movesQtm / (timeMs / 1000), rounded to two decimals; null without a time.

replayOk.description: The solve's moves take scrambledFacelets to solved in the simulator.

scrambleCorrected.description: The cube left the scramble's path during the scramble.

scrambleExtraMoves.description: Moves made during the scramble beyond the scramble's own, in quarter turns: one wrong quarter turn undone counts 2.

phases.description: The CFOP phases completed, in order (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §4): all eight for a solve its moves replay.

video.description: Phase 2: the video segments. Empty in schema version 1.

facelets.description: A cube state: 54 stickers in Kociemba order (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §2).

slot.description: F2L phases only: the pair's slot, named by its middle-layer edge position.
